forecasts.title: Shenzhou 24 lifts off between 00:08 and 00:48 UTC on 25 Nov 2026
forecasts.summary: Whether Long March 2F/G carrying Shenzhou 24 lifts off from Jiuquan inside the window of closure areas A6094/26 (ZXXX) and A6095/26 (ZSHA) that Launch matched to it on 20 Nov 2026.
raise_by: a further independent line of evidence (have 2, High needs 3)
examine and reject at least one alternative explanation
a scored Verdict record for this method version

reference.basis: Crewed Shenzhou flights 14 and 16-23 for which Launch's Joey0609 notice copy holds notices: 9 of 9 lifted off inside a notice window; LL2's update logs for Shenzhou 22 and 23 show no date change after the notices appeared (chosen by Tom, 20 Nov 2026). The plain rule is that record taken as it stands, 9 of 9 = 1.00. A small sample with no failures. For context only: LL2, 99 Chinese launches 3 Nov 2025 to 20 Nov 2026, CASC vehicles 61 of 73 (84%) and commercial vehicles 17 of 26 (65%) had no day-level schedule change logged after LL2 added them 'per NOTAMs'.

forecasts.rule: Yes if Long March 2F/G carrying Shenzhou 24 lifts off from Jiuquan between 00:08:00 and 00:48:59 UTC on 25 Nov 2026 (the window of closure area A6094/26 ZXXX as Launch's feed showed it on 20 Nov 2026). Lift-off time is the time given by Xinhua, CCTV or the China Manned Space Agency, else GCAT's launch time. No otherwise (later, on another day, scrubbed, or a replaced notice with any other window).
forecasts.resolution_source: Xinhua, CCTV, China Manned Space Agency (cmse.gov.cn); GCAT (planet4589.org) as fallback; Launch's feed for the registered window
forecasts.void_if: never on a schedule change: notices cancelled or replaced with a different window before or after 00:08 UTC 25 Nov count as No (Tom, 20 Nov 2026). Void only if the registered window cannot be read back from Launch's feed history.

alternatives.hypothesis: A delay of hours to days (the notices are replaced with a later window)
alternatives.tell_apart: new ZXXX/ZSHA notices with a later window, or an LL2 update 'delayed'; no state-media lift-off report on 25 Nov

alternatives.hypothesis: A scrub with no new date
alternatives.tell_apart: notices cancelled, LL2 reverts to NET TBD

alternatives.hypothesis: Lift-off earlier than the window
alternatives.tell_apart: a reported lift-off time before 00:08 UTC; not seen for a crewed launch

forecasts.title: The Xichang launch scheduled for 26 Nov 2026 carries a numbered Yaogan or Shiyan payload
forecasts.summary: Whether China's state media or CASC name the payload of the Long March 2D that Launch matched to closure areas A6099/26 (ZPKM) and A6100/26 (ZGZU) as a Yaogan or Shiyan satellite with a series number.
raise_by: a further independent line of evidence (have 2, High needs 3)
a scored Verdict record for this method version

reference.basis: Measured 21 Nov 2026 from GCAT and Launch's history (NotamForChina, Joey0609). Plain rule: Long March 2C/2D launches from Xichang at 34-36 deg since Sep 2017: 30 of 32 were a numbered Yaogan or Shiyan (28 Yaogan, 2 Shiyan); the other 2 were Xinjishu Shiyan, which this rule counts as No. For context: the 2-area ZPKM+ZGZU pattern with the far area at 567-572 NM: 4 of 5 since 2020 (Yaogan 42-01, Yaogan 43-03, Shiyan 30-01/02, Shiyan 30-03/04; the other was Einstein Probe, 29 deg, science). The same far ZGZU area on any vehicle: 8 of 9. All Long March 2D launches from Xichang since 2020: 19 of 23; the others were 1 Xinjishu Shiyan and 3 SatNet technology test launches (50 and 55 deg, a different pattern).

forecasts.rule: Yes if, within 48 hours of lift-off, Xinhua, CCTV, CASC or CNSA names the main payload of the orbital launch from Xichang matched to closure areas A6099/26 ZPKM and A6100/26 ZGZU (or to replacement notices for the same launch) as 遥感 (Yaogan) or 试验 (Shiyan) followed directly by a series number, for example 遥感四十三号 or 试验三十号. No if it is named any other way, including 新技术试验 (Xinjishu Shiyan) and any name in which 试验 follows another word, such as 卫星互联网技术试验 or 通信技术试验, or if it is not named within 48 hours. GCAT is used only to settle which series a state-media name belongs to. The vehicle (LL2: Long March 2D, 'uncertain') does not change the rule. Resolved on a check after 10:00 UTC on 28 Nov 2026, or 48 hours after lift-off if the launch is later.
forecasts.resolution_source: Xinhua, CCTV, CASC (spacechina.com), CNSA; GCAT (planet4589.org) for series membership
forecasts.void_if: the launch matched to these closures (or to replacement notices for the same launch) does not lift off from Xichang between 26 Nov and 3 Dec 2026 (UTC)

alternatives.hypothesis: Class 1: a numbered Yaogan (遥感) series
alternatives.tell_apart: Xinhua or CASC names the payload 遥感 followed by a number

alternatives.hypothesis: Class 2: a numbered Shiyan (试验) series
alternatives.tell_apart: named 试验 followed by a number (Shiyan 30-05/06 would continue the pairs launched 29 Sep 2025 and 12 Mar 2026 on the same bearing)

alternatives.hypothesis: Class 3: another Chinese government or state-company series (Xinjishu Shiyan, satellite-internet or communications technology test satellites, Shijian, Tianhui, Gaofen, Ziyuan, a science mission, SatNet/Guowang)
alternatives.tell_apart: named in one of those series

alternatives.hypothesis: Class 4: a commercial company's or a foreign customer's payload (Jilin-1, SuperView, PIESAT, Geely, foreign)
alternatives.tell_apart: named for a company constellation or foreign customer

alternatives.hypothesis: Class 5: not named within 48 h
alternatives.tell_apart: no state-media or CASC payload name by 09:35 UTC 28 Nov
